surveys.question: Have you heard of the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
surveys.notes: Data from preliminary 2026 survey results published May 2026. MCP was added as a new technology category. Among AI developers, 61% heard, 22% used, 6% paid.

surveys.question: Which AI protocols do you use?
surveys.notes: Published November 2025. MCP was listed alongside LangChain, OpenAI API. 12% of respondents using AI tools reported MCP usage.

surveys.question: Have you integrated MCP in your projects?
surveys.notes: Published December 2025. Among JS developers using AI, 55% heard, 18% used, 7% paid for MCP servers or tools.

surveys.question: Would you pay for a high-quality MCP server?
surveys.notes: Internal survey of 5,000 MCP-registered developers, March 2026. 12% already paid for at least one MCP server; 34% said they would pay in the future.

surveys.question: MCP-related repositories starred or forked?
surveys.notes: Published October 2025. 22% of AI-related repo visitors encountered MCP; 5% actively used MCP in their workflows.

aggregate_estimates.heard_of_mcp: 28-41% across general developer surveys, 55-61% among AI-focused developers

revenue_implication: If 12% of 5,000 MCP developers already paid, and extrapolated to ~200,000 active MCP developers globally (estimated), potential market: 24,000 paying users. At $10-50/month per MCP server subscription, monthly revenue opportunity: $240k-$1.2M. Agent-to-agent MCP servers for niche APIs (e.g., Stripe, GitHub, Notion) are prime targets.
